title: Research at no, partial and full overlap shows whether a shared coord store cuts duplicate facts or tokens beyond the spread
goal: multi has research scenarios at no overlap (three distinct areas, e.g. pip, rust, sops) and partial overlap (e.g. pip, uv, python) beside the full-overlap research scenario (pip three times), each runnable with coord=shared and coord=isolated; a paid run within the operator's spend cap, with research on Haiku 5.5, records 4 records per arm and level (24 records), and the report and token-efficiency.md (Concurrent agents) state per overlap level dup_facts, dedup_hits and tokens and USD per verified fact as ranges, and whether shared differs from isolated beyond the spread at each level

run:
import re,subprocess as s,sys
p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/benchmarks.py','report','--check'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=600)
md=open('kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
q=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/selfdoc.py','section','token-efficiency','Concurrent agents'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120).stdout
rows={k:[l for l in md.splitlines() if l.startswith('| '+k+' |')] for k in ('research-none','research-partial')}
lvl={k:bool(re.search(k.replace('-',r'[- ]')+r'|'+w,q,re.I)) for k,w in (('research-none','no overlap'),('research-partial','partial overlap'))}
terms=all(t in q for t in ('dup_facts','dedup_hits')) and re.search(r'per verified fact',q)
print('report --check',p.returncode,'table rows',{k:len(v) for k,v in rows.items()},'levels named',lvl,'metrics named',bool(terms))
sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==0 and all(rows.values()) and all(lvl.values()) and terms else 1)

import re,subprocess as s,sys
q=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/selfdoc.py','section','token-efficiency','Concurrent agents'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120).stdout
sent=re.split(r'(?<=[.;])\s+',q)
hit={k:any(re.search(k,x,re.I) and re.search(r'(beyond|within) the spread',x) and re.search(r'shared',x) and re.search(r'isolated',x) for x in sent) for k in (r'no overlap|research-none',r'partial overlap|research-partial',r'full overlap')}
print('a shared-against-isolated spread verdict per level:',hit);sys.exit(0 if all(hit.values()) else 1)

notes: Premise: python3 _tools/rag.py show kb/_self/token-efficiency.md:152 -n 1 shows record 00cb019, two records per arm, shared and isolated token ranges overlapping and dup_facts not lower under shared. kb/_self/reports/multi_bench.csv already runs research at full overlap (research-1..3 all on pip) and coord at partial (pip, uv), so overlap alone was not missing: the levels and the records per arm are. Areas must be bench_repro briefs (pip, uv, python, rust, sops and the rest of load_briefs). Model and records per arm are sized under the spend gate; Haiku research ran at about 3.40-6.21 USD per record, the Sonnet research dry run estimates 8.48 USD per scenario run. Plan check 2026-10-26: sized 4 records per arm and level (24) under g1's 150 USD cap. Dry runs: research, Haiku research $0.42 a scenario run (~$10 for 24); default Sonnet $8.48 (~$204, over the cap, so the goal names Haiku); recorded Haiku records $3.40-6.21 each, ~$82-149 for 24.
